edit.description: derive every claim path via git.tipClaimPath; anchor the clean-exit absence on a populated claim

summary: Route the tip-claim suite's seven hand-built claim paths through git.tipClaimPath, and populate the clean-exit test's claim before asserting it gone

per.section: A green verdict is proven non-vacuous

pins: flume loop --max 0 reclaims a stale tip claim at the derived path and leaves none behind
acceptance: No claim path in the suite is spelled by hand; the clean-exit test asserts a claim present before asserting it absent.
notes: Two tests judge the release guarantee by absence alone — "claim file is gone after a clean exit" (L205) and the detached-HEAD loop refusal (L387) — over a path hand-copied from src/git.ts:tipClaimPath. Drift leaves both permanently green over nothing. tests/git.test.ts, tests/cli.test.ts and tests/Dispatcher.test.ts already derive via the helper; this suite is the last hand-copy. Also engineering.md, The fix lands at the mechanism.
